systems.owner: Agência de Transformação Digital e Inovação, IP (ATDI)
systems.tiers: National web portal presented at FACIM 2026 (reported 2026-09-04): users consult requirements, submit requests, follow processes and obtain official documents remotely, across about 140 services taken in progressively, identification documents and civil registration among them

note: The portal is a single counter for requesting documents; the article says nothing about how civil registration offices register births or deaths.
